WITH member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM trips
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_id
),
avg_trip_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(trip_count) AS avg_cnt
  FROM member_trip_counts
),
qualified_members AS (
  SELECT mtc.member_id
  FROM member_trip_counts mtc
  CROSS JOIN avg_trip_count atc
  WHERE mtc.trip_count > atc.avg_cnt
),
station_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT t.start_station_id AS station_id, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM trips t
  JOIN qualified_members qm ON qm.member_id = t.member_id
  WHERE t.start_station_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.start_station_id
),
top_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id, trip_count
  FROM station_trip_counts
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC, station_id
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS station_count,
  SUM(trip_count) AS total_trips,
  AVG(trip_count) AS avg_trips_per_station
FROM top_stations

WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    AVG(capacity) AS avg_capacity
  FROM stations
  WHERE is_active = 1
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
eligible_jobs AS (
  SELECT m.completed_at
  FROM maintenance m
  JOIN stations s
    ON s.station_id = m.station_id
  JOIN station_avg sa
    ON sa.borough_id = s.borough_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1
    AND s.capacity > sa.avg_capacity
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS completion_percentage
FROM eligible_jobs

WITH model_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    bm.model_id,
    bm.model_name,
    bm.manufacturer,
    CASE WHEN bm.is_electric = 1 THEN 'electric' ELSE 'non-electric' END AS electric_status,
    m.job_id,
    m.bike_id,
    m.reported_at,
    m.completed_at,
    m.cost_cents,
    m.issue_type,
    julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at) AS repair_days
  FROM bike_models bm
  LEFT JOIN bikes b
    ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
  LEFT JOIN maintenance m
    ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id
),
issue_counts AS (
  SELECT
    model_id,
    issue_type,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM model_jobs
  WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY model_id, issue_type
),
top_issue AS (
  SELECT model_id, issue_type
  FROM (
    SELECT
      model_id,
      issue_type,
      cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY model_id
        ORDER BY cnt DESC, issue_type
      ) AS rn
    FROM issue_counts
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  mj.model_id,
  mj.model_name,
  mj.manufacturer,
  mj.electric_status,
  AVG(CASE WHEN mj.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN mj.repair_days END) AS avg_repair_time_days,
  COUNT(mj.job_id) AS total_maintenance_jobs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mj.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN mj.bike_id END) AS bikes_with_maintenance,
  AVG(mj.cost_cents) AS avg_maintenance_cost_cents,
  MAX(mj.cost_cents) AS max_maintenance_cost_cents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mj.completed_at IS NULL AND mj.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(mj.job_id), 0) AS open_job_share,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mj.issue_type) AS distinct_issue_types,
  ti.issue_type AS most_frequent_issue_type
FROM model_jobs mj
LEFT JOIN top_issue ti
  ON ti.model_id = mj.model_id
GROUP BY
  mj.model_id,
  mj.model_name,
  mj.manufacturer,
  mj.electric_status,
  ti.issue_type
ORDER BY
  avg_repair_time_days DESC,
  total_maintenance_jobs DESC

WITH borough_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) AS technician_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS station_count
  FROM boroughs b
  LEFT JOIN technicians t
    ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
  LEFT JOIN stations s
    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
)
SELECT
  borough_id,
  borough_name,
  technician_count,
  station_count,
  SUM(technician_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY technician_count ASC, borough_id ASC
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_total_technicians
FROM borough_counts
ORDER BY technician_count ASC, borough_id ASC

SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  MIN(t.started_at) AS first_trip_start_timestamp,
  MAX(t.ended_at) AS last_trip_end_timestamp,
  (julianday(MAX(t.ended_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at))) AS trip_history_span_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.bike_id) AS unique_bikes_used
FROM stations AS s
JOIN trips AS t
  ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
WHERE t.started_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.ended_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY trip_history_span_days DESC, s.station_id

SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  (julianday(MAX(t.started_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at))) AS span_days,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips_started,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_trips,
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((julianday(MAX(t.started_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at))), 0) AS starts_per_span_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF((julianday(MAX(t.started_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at))), 0) AS returned_per_span_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF((julianday(MAX(t.started_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at))), 0) AS unreturned_per_span_day
FROM stations AS s
JOIN trips AS t
  ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY unreturned_per_span_day DESC, s.station_id ASC

WITH member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM trips
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    trip_count,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY trip_count DESC, member_id ASC) AS quartile
  FROM member_trip_counts
),
top_quartile_members AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE quartile = 1
),
top_quartile_trips AS (
  SELECT
    t.trip_id,
    t.start_station_id,
    t.end_station_id
  FROM trips t
  JOIN top_quartile_members m
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  WHERE t.member_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN start_station_id = end_station_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS same_station_trip_pct
FROM top_quartile_trips

WITH per_bike AS (
  SELECT
    b.bike_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
    AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_trip_distance
  FROM bikes b
  JOIN bike_models bm
    ON bm.model_id = b.model_id
  JOIN trips t
    ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
  WHERE bm.is_electric = 1
    AND b.status = 'in_service'
  GROUP BY b.bike_id
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT avg_trip_distance
  FROM per_bike
  WHERE trip_count >= 20
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_trip_distance) AS overall_avg_distance
  FROM qualified
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified) = 0 THEN 'no_qualified_bikes'
    WHEN overall_avg_distance >= 8 THEN 'very_long_average_distance'
    WHEN overall_avg_distance >= 5 THEN 'long_average_distance'
    WHEN overall_avg_distance >= 3 THEN 'medium_average_distance'
    ELSE 'short_average_distance'
  END AS average_distance_band
FROM overall

WITH tech_counts AS (
  SELECT
    depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS technician_count,
    AVG(hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    MIN(hired_on) AS earliest_hire_date
  FROM technicians
  GROUP BY depot_borough_id
),
weather_stats AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS weather_record_count,
    AVG(temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c,
    AVG(precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm,
    SUM(CASE WHEN precip_mm >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS rainy_day_ratio,
    MAX(wind_kph) AS max_wind_kph
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
total_techs AS (
  SELECT SUM(technician_count) AS total_technicians
  FROM tech_counts
)
SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(tt.total_technicians, 0) AS technician_share_of_total,
  COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
  COALESCE(ws.weather_record_count, 0) AS weather_record_count,
  COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(b.population, 0) AS technicians_per_100k_residents,
  ws.avg_temp_c,
  ws.avg_precip_mm,
  ws.rainy_day_ratio,
  ws.max_wind_kph,
  tc.avg_hourly_rate_cents,
  tc.earliest_hire_date,
  CASE
    WHEN ws.avg_precip_mm >= 4 THEN 'wet'
    WHEN ws.avg_temp_c >= 20 THEN 'warm'
    WHEN ws.max_wind_kph >= 35 THEN 'windy'
    ELSE 'mild'
  END AS weather_profile_label
FROM boroughs b
LEFT JOIN tech_counts tc
  ON tc.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN weather_stats ws
  ON ws.borough_id = b.borough_id
CROSS JOIN total_techs tt
ORDER BY technician_share_of_total DESC, b.borough_name ASC

SELECT
  m.member_id,
  b.bike_id,
  COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
FROM members AS m
CROSS JOIN bikes AS b
LEFT JOIN trips AS t
  ON t.member_id = m.member_id
 AND t.bike_id = b.bike_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM trips AS t2
  WHERE t2.member_id = m.member_id
)
GROUP BY m.member_id, b.bike_id
HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) = 0
ORDER BY m.member_id, b.bike_id

WITH trip_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_trip_start,
    MAX(ended_at) AS last_trip_end,
    (julianday(MAX(ended_at)) - julianday(MIN(started_at))) AS trip_activity_span_days
  FROM trips
  WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bike_id
),
maintenance_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    MIN(date(reported_at)) AS first_maintenance_report_date,
    MAX(date(completed_at)) AS last_maintenance_completion_date,
    (julianday(MAX(date(completed_at))) - julianday(MIN(date(reported_at)))) AS maintenance_history_span_days,
    COUNT(*) AS total_maintenance_jobs
  FROM maintenance
  GROUP BY bike_id
)
SELECT
  tb.bike_id,
  tb.first_trip_start,
  tb.last_trip_end,
  tb.trip_activity_span_days,
  mb.first_maintenance_report_date,
  mb.last_maintenance_completion_date,
  mb.maintenance_history_span_days,
  mb.total_maintenance_jobs
FROM trip_bounds AS tb
JOIN maintenance_bounds AS mb
  ON mb.bike_id = tb.bike_id
ORDER BY tb.trip_activity_span_days DESC, tb.bike_id
LIMIT 25

WITH borough_station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_station_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_station_count
  FROM stations
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
borough_daily_precip AS (
  SELECT
    w.borough_id,
    w.day,
    w.precip_mm,
    bsc.active_station_count,
    bsc.total_station_count,
    (w.precip_mm / bsc.active_station_count) AS precip_per_active_station,
    (w.precip_mm / bsc.total_station_count) AS precip_per_all_stations
  FROM weather_daily w
  JOIN borough_station_counts bsc
    ON bsc.borough_id = w.borough_id
  WHERE bsc.active_station_count > 0
)
SELECT
  borough_id,
  AVG(precip_per_active_station) AS avg_daily_precip_per_active_station,
  AVG(precip_per_all_stations) AS avg_daily_precip_per_all_stations,
  AVG(precip_per_active_station) - AVG(precip_per_all_stations) AS difference
FROM borough_daily_precip
GROUP BY borough_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_precip_per_active_station DESC
